branded.why: One dairy's or company's product, sold in its shops but no part of a food culture beyond them.

about.text: A yoghurt made from water buffalo milk, which is richer than cow milk, so the yoghurt is rich too. Laos Buffalo Dairy in Luang Prabang pasteurises and homogenises the milk it collects daily from village herds before making its products.

sources.text: What it is and how it is made, from these.
